title: Bernanke, Boivin and Eliasz (2005) FAVAR panel
notes: 120 transformed macro series (BBE Table A.1 transformation codes already applied) plus the fed funds rate. Variable descriptions in bbe2005-variables.csv.

title: Blanchard and Quah (1989) output growth and unemployment
notes: Demeaned/detrended series as used in the paper: real GNP growth and the unemployment rate.

title: Gertler and Karadi (2015) monetary VAR with high-frequency instruments
notes: Log CPI, log IP, policy rates, Treasury yields, Gilchrist-Zakrajsek EBP, mortgage and CP spreads. ff_exp1yr is NA before 1983.

title: Stock and Watson (2001) three-variable VAR
notes: Inflation (annualised QoQ), unemployment and the fed funds rate, 1960Q1-2000Q4.

title: Uhlig (2005) sign-restriction monetary VAR
notes: Real GDP (interpolated), CPI, commodity prices, fed funds, non-borrowed and total reserves.

title: Phillips, Shi and Yu (2015) S&P 500 price-dividend ratio
notes: Real S&P 500 price and dividend from Shiller's data, price-dividend ratio and its 1973-01 = 100 index. Used in the `exuber` package.

title: Kilian and Lutkepohl (2017) textbook monetary VAR
notes: Real GDP growth, fed funds rate and inflation, 1954Q4-2007Q4 (Chapter 2).

title: Kilian and Lutkepohl (2017) textbook oil VAR
notes: Real oil price growth, inflation and real GDP growth, 1973Q1-2013Q2 (Chapter 2).

title: NBER business cycle reference dates
notes: Peak and trough months and contraction length in months. Handy for shading recessions in plots.
